title: Watchdog configuration
description: Configuration for the one-shot service-watchdog.sh monitor. Dynamic checks such as dependency cycles, installed time zones and command allowlists still require `service-watchdog.sh validate`.

settings.description: Runtime paths and default check/action timing.

services.description: Services to monitor; an empty array is allowed for a federation hub.

templates.description: Reusable partial service definitions, merged before Bash validation.

hooks.description: Commands run on failure and recovery transitions.

federation.description: Optional one-shot agent or hub mode.

status_page.description: Static HTML and JSON status page output.

history.description: Optional per-check snapshots, rotation and terminal reports.

discovery.description: Optional offline draft generator settings, read by watchdog-discover.sh rather than the monitor.

envName.description: Environment variable name; never put its secret value in YAML.

positiveInteger.description: Positive whole number; quoted digits are accepted for compatibility with yq/Bash.

nonNegativeInteger.description: Non-negative whole number; quoted digits are accepted for compatibility with yq/Bash.

timeRange.description: Same-day HH:MM-HH:MM interval; validate also checks that start precedes end.

scalarArg.description: A command argument passed directly as argv, without shell evaluation.

argv.description: Executable followed by arguments; no shell string or eval.

commandStep.description: A directly executed command with optional working directory and timeout.

command.description: Executable and arguments as an argv array.

working_directory.description: Existing working directory; checked on the host by validate.

timeout.description: Maximum command runtime in seconds; defaults to settings.default_action_timeout.

commandSequence.description: Ordered commands, run directly without a shell.

state_directory.description: Persistent service and incident state directory.

default_retry_delay.description: Delay between check attempts in seconds.

default_action_timeout.description: Default timeout for action and hook commands.

httpHeader.description: A literal HTTP header or a header whose value is read from an environment variable.

value.description: Literal non-secret header value; do not use for credentials.

value_env.description: Environment variable containing a secret header value; its value is never persisted or logged.

httpExpect.description: Optional assertions applied after an HTTP status is accepted.

content_type.description: Expected response media type. Parameters such as charset are ignored.

body_regex.description: Extended regular expression that must match the response body. Response capture is limited to 64 KiB.

max_total_ms.description: Maximum total HTTP duration in milliseconds. A slower successful response is degraded and never triggers remediation.

checkFields.description: HTTP, TCP, DNS, ICMP ping, direct command, disk-space, TLS certificate, or security check. Partial fields are allowed when inherited from a template.

type.description: Check transport, DNS records, ICMP reachability, filesystem, TLS certificate expiry, antivirus, or threshold source.

success_status.description: Accepted HTTP status codes; defaults to the 2xx range.

headers.description: Additional HTTP request headers. Use value_env for secrets.

expect.description: Optional HTTP response assertions and latency SLO.

host.description: TCP or TLS host name or address.

port.description: TCP destination port, or TLS port (defaults to 443 for tls_cert).

server_name.description: TLS SNI server name; defaults to host.

min_days_remaining.description: Minimum whole days remaining before the TLS leaf certificate expires.

record_type.description: DNS record type queried through dig.

resolver.description: Optional DNS resolver hostname or address; the system resolver is used by default.

min_answers.description: Minimum non-empty dig +short answers required for a DNS check.

expected_answers.description: Exact dig +short answer lines that must all be present.

count.description: Number of ICMP echo packets sent by a ping check.

max_packet_loss_percent.description: Maximum allowed ICMP packet loss percentage.

max_avg_rtt_ms.description: Optional maximum average ICMP round-trip time in milliseconds.

commands.description: Commands whose exit status determines health.

path.description: Absolute file or directory path on the filesystem to measure with df.

min_free_gb.description: Minimum available space in GiB; disk check fails below this threshold.

min_free_percent.description: Minimum available percentage; disk check fails below this threshold.

source.description: Event or socket source for a threshold check.

threshold.description: Non-negative count threshold that triggers a failure when comparator is true.

comparator.description: Comparison between observed count and threshold.

timeout.description: Per-attempt timeout in seconds; defaults to settings.default_timeout, or 300 seconds for clamav.

retry_delay.description: Seconds between attempts; defaults to settings.default_retry_delay.

since.description: journald --since interval, such as 5 minutes ago.

pattern.description: Extended regular expression used to count matching lines.

tail_lines.description: How many recent log lines to inspect; not a precise time window.

command.description: Command whose output is a count or contains lines matching pattern.

timeout.description: Timeout for a command source, overriding check.timeout.

check.description: Complete check definition after template expansion.

liveness.description: HTTP liveness check; may inherit fields from a template.

readiness.description: HTTP readiness check; may inherit fields from a template.

health.description: Both liveness and readiness must be complete HTTP checks.

max_delay.description: Maximum delay in seconds; validate also checks that it is not below initial_delay.

httpRemediation.description: A remote HTTP remediation request. Use header value_env or body_env for secrets.

url.description: Remote API endpoint. Prefer HTTPS and authentication headers rather than signed query strings.

headers.description: Request headers. Use value_env for credentials.

body_env.description: Environment variable containing a request body; never logged or persisted.

timeout.description: Connection and total request timeout in seconds; defaults to settings.default_action_timeout.

success_status.description: Accepted status codes; defaults to the 2xx range.

httpRemediationAllowlist.description: Exact HTTP method and URL permitted when remediation policy enforce mode is active.

http.description: Remote HTTP remediation requests run after commands in order.

cooldown.description: Minimum seconds between remediation attempts; defaults to settings.default_action_cooldown.

verify_after.description: Seconds to wait before a post-action readiness check.

backoff.description: Exponential retry delay after failed remediation.

onlyIf.description: Condition that gates a service check.

command.description: Direct argv command for a command condition.

exit_code.description: Expected exit code or set of accepted exit codes.

path.description: Absolute path for file or filesystem conditions.

days.description: Days when a time-window condition matches.

timezone.description: Installed IANA timezone; validate checks availability.

min_free_gb.description: Minimum free disk space in GiB.

maintenance.description: Suppress notifications, remediation and hooks during configured windows while checks continue.

timezone.description: Installed IANA timezone; empty uses the host timezone.

name.description: Human-readable window name; defaults to window-N.

threshold.description: Transitions required to enter flapping state.

recovery_seconds.description: Stable health period required to leave flapping state.

escalationLevel.description: One incident-level escalation threshold, fired once per incident.

after_consecutive_unavailable.description: Escalate after this many unavailable runs.

after_failed_remediations.description: Escalate after this many failed remediation attempts.

manual_intervention.description: Block further remediation until manual intervention.

after_duration_seconds.description: Escalate after incident duration in seconds.

manual_intervention.description: Block further remediation until manually cleared.

circuitBreaker.description: Stop repeated failing remediation until the circuit closes.

half_open_verify_after.description: Seconds to wait before half-open verification.

on_open.description: Commands invoked when the circuit opens.

on_close.description: Commands invoked when the circuit closes.

serviceFields.description: Service fields; templates may provide any subset. Template name/template_mode/name entries are ignored by Bash when placed inside a template.

name.description: Unique service name; ignored inside templates.

parallel.description: Override the global parallel check setting for this service.

template.description: Reusable template name; ignored inside templates.

template_mode.description: How to merge the referenced template; ignored inside templates.

check.description: Health check; may inherit fields from a template.

health.description: Separate HTTP liveness and readiness checks.

actions.description: Remediation commands, cooldown, verification and backoff.

only_if.description: Conditions that must pass before a check runs.

name.description: Name of an existing service checked first.

required.description: If true, failed dependency blocks this service's check.

depends_on.description: Ordered service dependencies; cycles are checked by validate.

service.description: A monitored service. A template reference permits partial check fields until the template is merged.

on_failure.description: Commands invoked on a failure transition.

mode.description: Legacy behavior or exact remediation command/HTTP allowlist enforcement.

allowed_commands.description: Exact allowed remediation argv vectors; validate also checks executable safety.

allowed_http.description: Exact remote HTTP method/URL pairs permitted for remediation in enforce mode.

timeout.description: Fallback per-check timeout; 0 disables this limit.

temp_dir.description: Optional absolute temporary directory; empty uses /tmp.

filename.description: Metrics file name, not a path.

static_labels.description: Additional scalar labels; service and check_type are reserved.

json_filename.description: Optional JSON output file name; empty disables JSON.

auto_refresh.description: Browser refresh interval in seconds; 0 disables refresh.

uptime.description: Optional observed-availability bars sourced from history snapshots.

enabled.description: Render observed-availability bars; requires status_page.enabled and history.enabled.

days.description: Trailing calendar duration represented by the bars.

buckets.description: Number of equal observed-availability intervals to render.

primary.description: Primary RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

danger.description: Down RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

warning.description: Warning RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

bg.description: Background RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

card.description: Card RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

text.description: Text RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

muted.description: Muted RGB hex color without #; empty uses the default.

password_env.description: Environment variable containing the SMTP password.

password.description: Legacy inline password; prefer password_env and never commit a secret.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification; unsafe outside testing.

enabled.description: Send failure and recovery email on transitions.

bot_token_env.description: Environment variable holding the bot token.

token_env.description: Optional bearer-token environment variable; empty means no token.

priority.description: ntfy priority: 1-5, min, low, default, high, urgent or max.

enabled.description: Send PagerDuty Events API v2 trigger and resolve events.

routing_key_env.description: Environment variable containing the PagerDuty Events API routing key.

template.description: Plain-text message templates for failure, recovery and escalation.

enabled.description: Send Opsgenie Alert API create and close events.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable containing the Opsgenie API key.

region.description: Opsgenie API region; eu selects api.eu.opsgenie.com.

template.description: Plain-text message templates for failure, recovery and escalation.

webhook_url_env.description: Environment variable holding the webhook URL.

node_id.description: Node ID; empty in Bash defaults to hostname -s.

enabled.description: Send local reports to the hub.

transport.description: HTTP push or atomic local file report.

heartbeat.description: Report even if state did not change.

max_report_age.description: Seconds until a report is stale.

archive_retention_days.description: Days to retain archived reports; 0 disables cleanup.

expected_nodes.description: Node IDs to expect, including offline nodes.

agent_offline.description: Notify when an agent stops reporting.

any_service_change.description: Notify on any service state change.

enabled.description: Record one snapshot per completed service check; disabled by default.

storage.description: JSON Lines needs no extra dependency; SQLite requires the optional sqlite3 CLI.

path.description: JSONL directory or SQLite database file. Defaults inside settings.state_directory.

mode.description: Daily JSONL files or one rolling JSONL file; ignored for SQLite.

max_age_days.description: Delete old daily files or SQLite rows after this many days; 0 disables age cleanup.

max_records.description: Retain at most this many JSONL lines in single mode; 0 means unlimited.

fields.description: Stored fields. timestamp, service and state are required for reports; all fields are stored by default.

enabled.description: Enable the separately invoked offline generator.

output_dir.description: Output directory; empty writes to stdout.

output_prefix.description: Prefix for generated discovery YAML file.

only_with_healthcheck.description: Include only Compose services with a healthcheck.

default_actions.description: Draft remediation actions for discovered Compose services.

sources.description: Unit files, directories or glob patterns.

detect_ports.description: Guess a TCP or HTTP port from ExecStart.

default_actions.description: Draft remediation actions for discovered units.
